notes.title: Partial Controller Support and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Slime's Revenge will now be playable with a controller. Please note that the game was designed with mouse controls in mind and so menus are still navigated with cursor however the levels can now be played using the left stick and the A button. 

Changes in this update:

 In-level controller support
 Fixed a bug preventing player's from attaining coin-based achievements
 Fixed a bug that would crash the game when the player beat the final boss with all coins
 Added a Boop sound to menu buttons
